about: Lane ARK-ANTS (2026-11-23). How each of the Ark's ant kinds forages, read by hand from its own Field Guide text (species_field_guide: signature_traits, interesting_facts, diet_summary, species_subtitle_story; read-only export 2026-11-23) and the true-scale table (docs/ark/true-scale-sizes.tsv). `cite` quotes the stored phrase that decided each field; `estimate` lists the fields with no stored number (a flagged guess, never a fact). Visual only: what the engine decides (fed, deaths) is never changed here. Panda ant and red velvet ant are wingless wasps (velvet ants), solitary, never colonies: form none. Ant Mimic Mantis is not an ant.

forms.trail: a finder lays a scent trail home; nestmates stream both ways along it while the food lasts
forms.column: army ants: a broad swarm front, a column behind it, a temporary nest (bivouac) that moves
forms.leafcut: a cleared highway to a plant; workers carry leaf pieces held upright
forms.harvest: foragers walk out alone and come home with single seeds; a cleared patch round the nest
forms.solo: each forager searches alone and brings food home in its jaws; no trail
forms.homing: searches alone on a winding path, then runs home in a straight line; no trail
